title: Youth commission brochure and web page updates
summary: In July 2026 the Commission on Children and Youth planned a new brochure draft and a list of website changes for the next meeting. In August it approved the brochure with a section on how to testify and voted to send recommended web page updates to the department.

timeline.text: Motion to send recommended website updates to the department: Commissioners approved sending a list of recommended updates for the commission's county web page.
The chair will make the brochure revision and send the final version to the commission secretary to distribute.
Motion to move forward with the brochure with the requested revision: Commissioners approved moving forward with the brochure, with a revision adding how to testify.
The chair will develop a list of website changes for approval at the next meeting.
A new brochure draft will be prepared for the next meeting.
